intro.text: An Elendel cab driver who works for Ashweather Carriage and Coach.

items.text: Chapaou had driven for Ashweather for several years. The night of Lady ZoBell's party he took coach sixteen to collect a passenger booked under a Terris name meaning "secret", whose hands were red. Hearing noises inside, he looked in and saw a "mistwraith" wearing a twisted copy of his own face. At Lestib Square, Bleeder climbed up beside him, whispered to him and fled.

Shaken by what he found left in the coach, Chapaou paid for a private session at a Soothing parlor on Decan Street, but was too upset to do anything but pace. Wax traced him there through the company's records, and outside by the carriage Chapaou told him the story while Wax examined the bones and the bloody mallet. Wax gave him a few banknotes before leaving.

personality.text: His encounter with Bleeder badly unnerved him, and for a time he believed he had committed a murder himself.
